text:
TDS::session
Description
This command returns TDS session data.
Syntax
TDS
::
session
username
TDS
::
session
dbname
TDS
::
session
loginoption
TDS
::
session
version
TDS::session username
returns the username
TDS::session dbname
returns the database name
TDS::session loginoption
returns the login option
TDS::session version
returns the TDS version
Examples
when
TDS_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"TDS request received from [TDS::session username]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
TDS_REQUEST,TDS_RESPONSE
